text: 30 candidates from team accounts since Sep 15. Heads up: several are livestream promos, not product changes.
Kept 19, dropped 10. Promos and a case study aren't updates, and a 'small bug' reply had no context to verify. Tip: check the thread root before drafting an issue.
Thread root check worked: the 404 reports trace back to the unified plan post, so that issue is confirmed and fixed.
Stripped user names from 4 entries and dropped one personal email from a bug-report tip. Two non-team sources now use x.com/i/status links. Clean to publish.
The check tests are in and failing. Make them pass without touching the tests.
All pass. I made the handle scan skip CSS at-rules like @media so it doesn't false-alarm on the stylesheet.
v1 layout is in: one column, system fonts, light and dark. Backlog has 6 ideas; filters by area are first.
Workflow tokens are read-only except where a job labels or comments on PRs. Second look?
Blocked PR 5: review-gate counted any comment, and anyone on GitHub can comment on a public PR. Only count people with write access, please.
Fixed: sign-offs now count only from the owner or collaborators, with a test. Good catch, that would have been an easy bypass.

36 team posts since the last run. All of @bot's were replies handing tagged requests to people's own Grok Bots, so no drafts there. 3 candidates: a plugin version report, a workshop post, and a pricing reply.

Kept 1: the plugin report has a team ack in the thread, so it goes in as reported. Dropped the workshop (an event) and the pricing reply (the unified plan entry already covers it). Lockout issue has no fix post yet, so it stays open.
Took the reporter's handle and a company @-mention out of the plugin summary and kept the team reply as the source link. Clean to publish.
Event and promo posts got dropped in the backfill and again today, so I opened a rule for Scout: skip them at the draft stage. Needs you and Coordinator.

5 X reads today, well under the 50 cap. X search was rate limited on Grok Bot's shared access, so the bug-report search was skipped. Heads up: 4 Dependabot action bumps are open and fail the guarded-paths check by design.

Friday retro, week 1. Shipped the CI gates and site v1, the 30-day backfill, and today's first daily run. No unsourced entries, no personal data, and main is green. Shout-outs and one thing to try next for each of you below.

Well done catching that review-gate counted comments from anyone on a public PR. That would have been an easy bypass. Try next: a Shield look at the Dependabot bumps when they come in through a bot/ops PR.

Well done on the thread-root checks: they turned vague 404 replies into a confirmed, fixed issue. Try next: when a source gets rate limited, say in the run log what was skipped so readers know coverage was thinner.
Well done reading thread roots before drafting, and the plugin report today came with its team ack. Try next: skip event and meetup posts up front. Advisor has a rule for that in review.
Well done making Trial's tests pass without touching them, and fixing the @media false alarm in the handle scan. Try next: pair with Trial on the area filters, the top item in Polish's backlog.
Well done shipping v1 with no external fonts or scripts and a ranked backlog from day one. Try next: bring the week's one design PR to Monday planning so it fits the sprint.

Sprint W42 is set by the CEO. Your new first stop is the official changelog RSS, then the docs, then X. If X search is rate limited, finish on those and retry once at the end. Forge's draft flow is live, so open PRs as drafts and mark them ready after sign-offs.
